notes:
SCOPE: E4 test from framework/CATEGORIES_v0_8.md (highest). Hunting knives, Bowie and fighting knives, butterfly and automatic knives, martial-arts weapons and armour are E4 kinds; kitchen knives B5, pocket/EDC C1, HEMA trainers E2.
ACCURACY: 25 sampled (random.seed(7)), all 25 shown on their src page and claims supported (0 wrong). Minor: Bill Sowell is on ABS directory page 2 (?ps&pn=2&limit=100), not the src URL; ABS names carry directory suffixes to clean ('- Retired ABS Instructor', '-Retired', 'MS RETIRED', 'PHD', '- Retired Master'). Wikipedia-category claims are listing-only (standing = own article). Everest Forge, Optics Trade and outfit4events items are seller pages: tier 'listed'.
CAVEATS CHECKED: (1) state arsenals and military-only makers listed as drops; Tula/Izhevsk dropped pending their civilian brands (TOZ, Baikal); Kalashnikov kept because Kalashnikov USA appears on the fetched US category page; Zastava, Lithgow, Łucznik, Armscor, Truvelo, Manufacture d'armes de Bayonne kept as civilian sellers (check). (2) ABS: the directory gives no blade type; ABS rating is quality (premium) and its core work (Bowie, hunting, fighting knives, swords) is E4, so keep by default; only Bob Kramer moved (B5). Folding-knife specialists for C1 not established from fetched pages (Dunkerley site blocked). ABS country field reads 'US (some abroad)' for all 118; websites show members in Brazil (Berardo, Franco de Souza), Argentina (Montenegro), South Africa (Heather and Kevin Harvey, Heavin Forge; Neels Van Den Berg) and France (Jean Louis Regel): set countries per profile. (3) Optics Trade riflescope list and Czech armourers are existence only; PRB 2026 survey independently supports Kahles (13% of pros) and Leupold (18%) as premium. (4) HEMA directory and Everest Forge: existence only; Regenyei and Arms & Armor are already in the register under E2; Red Dragon Armoury makes HEMA trainers (E2) unless a sharp line is shown. (5) Japanese names: Gassan Sadakazu II (月山貞一, LNT) and Gassan Sadatoshi (月山貞利, real name 月山清, current mukansa) are different people; do NOT merge. 'Masamine Sumitani' = 隅谷正峯 and 'Akitsugu Amata' = 天田昭次 (both LNT on ja.wikipedia): normalise to surname-first Sumitani Masamine, Amata Akitsugu; 'Ono Yoshimitsu' is 大野義光 (Ōno, real name 吉川三男). No literal duplicates found. (6) Register dedupe: Boss & Co. and Lebeau-Courally are not in the register (register 'Boss' is Hugo Boss/Boss audio, a homonym: do not merge); Hodgdon appears only as register 'Hodgdon Powder Company' and not in the harvest. HOMONYMS: Grulla/Garbi none in register; Bury (Liège) must not match Bradbury etc.; Alpen Optics ≠ register Alpen (C2); Steiner = Steiner-Optik (E6) not Steiner 1888; Arrow (A1 shirts) unrelated; Kramer (E3 guitars) ≠ Bob Kramer; register 'Kanefusa' (C1 hand saws) ≠ Fujiwara Kanefusa swordsmiths; register 'Parker Brothers' (E1 games) ≠ Parker Bros. guns; register 'Excalibur' E4 row reads 'food dehydrators' (wrong dept: Excalibur crossbows); register 'Walther' reads 'calculators', 'Remington' 'grooming appliances', 'Zeiss' 'spectacle lenses', 'Browning' 'gun safes', 'Wilkinson Sword' 'razors', 'Wham-O' frisbee in E4: dept text for E4 should be fixed. Register E4 adds: E.J. Churchill (A1), Mace and SABRE (B8), Eickhorn and Puma knives (C1: bayonets and hunting knives are E4 kinds), Shureido (E2: kobudo weapons are E4 kinds, no page fetched).
THIN AREAS RETRIED: NBTHK award lists (got 2024/2025 Gendai Toshoku-ten catalogues: mukansa smiths, horimono and koshirae makers); contemporary tosogu (only koshirae/horimono makers; tsuba makers not named in fetched text); Seki (Fujiwara Kanefusa house) and Bizen Osafune (Ando Hiroyasu, Sone Masanori, Katayama Shigetsune); Gardone (Fabbri, Bosis, Piotti, FAMARS, Guerini, FAIR, Rizzini, Zoli, Perugini & Visini); Toledo (Mariano Zamorano); keris empu (Djeno and Sungkowo Harumbrodjo; Aeng Tong-Tong as region); Kubachi (factory and Gazimagomedov dynasty); reproduction armour (Hedgecock, Wade Allen, MacPherson, Toman; Marutake for Japanese armour). Still thin: archery accessories (Beiter, Shibuya not paged), holsters beyond Safariland/Bianchi, firearm parts (Geissele, Timney, Bartlein not paged), modern ballistic helmets/plates (Ops-Core, Crye: Crye already in register A1), Africa (no named maker beyond Truvelo/ABS South Africans; Nguni shields, Tuareg takoba not searched to a page), South Asia (Pakistan only state factory; Darra not paged), Philippines barong/kampilan makers.
REGIONS ARE NOT QUOTAS: firearms, optics and ammunition are concentrated in Europe/North America; empty regions there are not counted as omissions.
